transcription.text: - I came to say goodbye. - But why, Boris? Why? - I've made up my mind. I'm going away. - Then I should be alone. - That journey into the desert you've spoken of, you will take it alone? - What else can I do? - Once you said to me that peace and happiness might be found there. You gave me hope. And now... now we have to say goodbye. - Goodbye. Lying in my bed, I hear the clock tick and think of you. Caught up in circles, confusion is nothing new. Flashback, warm nights, almost left behind. Suitcase of memories, time after... Sometimes you picture me, I'm walking too far ahead. You're calling to me, I can't hear what you've said. Then you say, "Go slow," I fall behind. The second hand unwinds. If you're lost, you can look and you will find me, time after time. If you fall, I will catch you, I'll be waiting, time after time.
